Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Content: A Green Team and a Blue Team prepare for a shopping cart race. They carry out an investigation that will help them so they can do well in the race. They used a spring scale to measure the force in `text(newtons)` (`text(N)=text(newtons)`). The procedure and a diagram of the experimental setup are shown.

:ibox:`bbtext(Procedure)`:

`1`. Place `25` `text(kg)` of groceries in a shopping cart.
`2`. Attach a rope and a spring scale to the front of the shopping cart.
`3`. Have a runner pull the cart `10` `text(meters)` across a parking lot as fast as they can.
`4`. Use the spring scale to measure the amount of force, in `text(newtons)`, the runner applies to the cart while pulling.
`5`. Measure the time it takes for the runner to pull the cart `10` `text(meters)`.
`6`. Use the time and distance to calculate the speed of the runner.
`7`. Repeat the steps for `text(each runner)`.
The data collected during the investigation are shown in the table.
